name: Cairo, Nile Cruise and Desert Egypt Safari
description: Our carefully Cairo, Nile Cruise and Desert Egypt Safari package is designed to give you a memorable experience. Enjoy a visit to the Pyramids, walkthrough White, and Black Desert, stare at the amazement of Hatshepsut Temple and more.
overview: Our carefully Cairo, Nile Cruise and Desert Egypt Safari package is designed to give you a memorable experience. Enjoy a visit to the Pyramids, walkthrough White, and Black Desert, stare at the amazement of Hatshepsut Temple and more.
highlights: Cleopatra Spring, Alexander the Great Temple and Great Sand Sea

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at local restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches), visit Ben Ezra synagogue, at the end of your day tours back to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Alexandria Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, Today is different day, as you will visit Alexandria city located at the the Mediterranean Sea by air-conditioned vehicle, where you can taste different culture by visiting Cata Comb of Kom El-Shokafa, Qaitbai Citadel, and Alexandria Library from outside, walk through the magnificent Montazah Palace, or try to amuse your eyes by visiting Roman amphitheatre ( If visit was allowed ), manage to realx by having lunch at local restaurant, then transfer to your hotel in Alexandria for a check in. Overnight in Alexandria

itinerary.title: Siwa Oasis Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, today you will discover the hidden secrets of the Egyptian Safari, start to drive by four-wheel-drive Jeep to Siwa Oasis, it is about 600 Km., discover the old Siwan village of Shali, finally transfer to your hotel in Siwa, and have dinner. Overnight in Siwa

itinerary.title: Cleopatra Spring, Alexander the Great Temple and Great Sand Sea
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, start to your adventure excursions to discover the mysterious secrets of Siwa, visit the Spring of Cleopatra, then move to the Mountain of the Dead, next tour to Alexander The Great Temple ( Known as Oracle Temple ), Try different experience for tour around the city by Donkey drawn-car, then enjoy Lunch, next tour to the Great Sand Sea, it is about 17-km., manage to relax at the hot spring at Bir Wahid, Dinner included. Overnight in Siwa Oasis

itinerary.title: Bahariya Oasis Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, then start to drive by four-wheel-drive Jeep to to Bahariya Oasis, passing by Bahrein, next move to Nawemis and Sitra Oasis, Lunch will be served during the tour, and then you will pass by the ravishing sand dunes of the Great Sand Sea. Once you arrive to Bahariya Oasis, Ibis Egypt tours representative will help you for check in, then have dinner. Overnight in Bahariya Oasis

itinerary.title: Golden Mummies, English Mountain and Crystal Mountain
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, today you will start to discover the beauty of Bahariya Oasis, start visiting Alexander the great Temple, Next tour to the Nobles tombs, then move to Golden Mummies, proceed to the English Mountain, last point will be to the crystal mountain. Lunch will be served during the tour, then drive by four-wheel-drive Jeep to the white Desert, it around 160-km., once you arrive the White Desert, scout the formations, as well as the wind carved sculptures that sympathize both human and animal faces, scout the formations that sympathize the flatness of a different planet., next drive to Farafra Oasis, it is around 40-km. Then have your dinner. Overnight in Farafra Oasis

itinerary.title: Dakhla Oasis Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, today you will start to discover the beauty of the old city of Farafra Oasis including Badr Museum “ It was the local Artist “, Then drive to Dakhla Oasis, it is around 280 km., start to scout Dakhla Oasis by visiting the Old Covered City watch its oil press and school, the courthouse with its dwelling chambers, Lunch will be served during the Tour, Proceed to visit Muzzawaka ( It is an external visit ), next tour to Deir El Haggar, then have dinner. Overnight in Dakhla Oasis

itinerary.title: Kharga Oasis Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, today you will explore kharga Oasis, drive by four-wheel-drive Jeep to kharga Oasis, It is around 190km., once you arrive Kharga visit the remote Roman village of Qasr El Labakha, picnic lunch will be served during the tour, Next tour to the Museum of Kharga, then proceed to Temple of Hibis (It is external visit), visit El Bagawat Cemetery, then have dinner. Overnight in Kharga Oasis

itinerary.title: Arrive Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, then drive by four-wheel-drive Jeep to to Luxor, It is around 350 km., lunch will be served on the way to Luxor, One you arrive Luxor, Ibis Egypt tours representative will help you for check in. Overnight in Luxor

itinerary.title: Karnak and Luxor Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at hotel, then transfer by air-conditioned van to your Nile Cruise by Ibis Egypt tours Air-conditioned van, enjoy a special excursion to visit Karnak and Luxor Temples. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank of Luxor Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast on board your Nile Cruise, watch life unfold as you sail the Nile, start your round to visit Valley of the Kings, head out towards the Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, finally visit the impressive Colossi of Memnon, Lunch on board your Nile Cruise, sail to Edfu, then have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, head out towards the Temple of Horus in Edfu, amuse your eyes while Sailing to Kom Ombo, pay a visit to the Temple shared by Two Gods Sobek and Horus, Sail to Aswan while tasting your Lunch on board, then have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, today taste an unforgettable excursions to the High Dam, head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Lunch on board your Nile Cruise, then have dinner. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast on board your Nile Cruise, today is your flight back to Cairo, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Aswan Domestic Airport, catch your flight back to Cairo, meet & assist at Cairo domestic Airport, transfer to hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.
